subject: MUEN
title: Introductory Opera Repertoire Experience
description: Instruction on Acting Methods, Aria as Monologue, theatrical movement, and script/score analysis as well as take part in production singing roles, covering roles, and/or singing in the ensemble. The course culminates in a Scenes Program that may include repertoire from the last 400 years of opera, operetta, Singspiel, opéra comique, musical theatre, and 21st century works.

subject: MUEN
title: Opera Studio
description: Coachings, rehearsals, stagings, technical/dress rehearsals in the theatre, and performances in front of an audience.
notes: For Music students; open to others by permission of the Department.
For undergraduate voice majors cast in roles in Opera McGill productions.

subject: MUEN
title: Chamber Music Project 1
description: Chamber music ensemble for various instruments.

restrictions.text: Open to undergraduate and graduate Performance students

subject: MUEN
title: Chamber Music Project 2
description: Chamber music ensemble for various instruments.

restrictions.text: Open to undergraduate and graduate Performance students

subject: MUEN
title: Vocal Chamber Ensemble
description: Vocal ensemble repertoire written after 1800.

restrictions.text: Open by audition to pianists and singers.

subject: MUEN
title: Introduction to Collaborative Piano 1
description: Aspects and techniques of performing in ensembles, including vocal accompanying, piano duos, instrumental duos and chamber ensemble work. Ensemble score-reading, preparation and performance analysis.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken MUEN 583

subject: MUEN
title: Introduction to Collaborative Piano 2
description: Developing the collaborative performance. Masterclass-style coaching of assignments in vocal accompanying, piano duos, instrumental duos and chamber ensemble work. Further ensemble score-reading, preparation and performance analysis.

subject: MUEN
title: Chamber Music Ensemble
description: Ensemble for chamber music - various instruments.

restrictions.text: For Music students; open to others by permission of the Department.

subject: MUEN
title: 2nd Chamber Music Ensemble
description: Chamber music of the Medieval, Renaissance and Baroque periods.

subject: MUEN
title: Guitar Ensemble
description: Performance of guitar ensemble repertoire and transcriptions throughout music history and in various genres.

subject: MUEN
title: Jazz Vocal Workshop
description: Vocal workshop for jazz musicians.

subject: MUEN
title: String Quartet Seminar
description: An overview of the history of the string quartet genre and literature for this formation. Basic principles of string ensemble playing, intonation, matching sound production, cueing, etc., will be addressed. Regular performances in a masterclass setting. Participation in an orchestra program as assigned when warranted by ensemble needs.

restrictions.text: Open to violin, viola and cello students in the BMus. / LMus. Performance program, and others by permission of the instructor.

notes: 2. Students majoring in violin, viola and cello must commence their assigned ensembles with two terms of MUEN 565 and two terms of MUEN 560 as assigned string quartets.

subject: MUEN
title: Beethoven Orchestra
description: A reading orchestra that also functions as a conductor's workshop orchestra. Repertoire includes the complete Beethoven Symphonies.
notes: Note: Open to all students registered at McGill.

subject: MUEN
title: Multiple Ensemble 1
description: Special arrangement ensemble. Topic varies by year.

subject: MUEN
title: Tabla Ensemble
description: Performance and practice of the tabla of North India.
notes: Can be taken more than once.

subject: MUEN
title: Jazz Combo
description: A Jazz Improvisation Ensemble of approximately 4 to 9 players.

subject: MUEN
title: Jazz Combo Project
description: A Jazz Improvisation Ensemble of approximately 4 to 9 players.

restrictions.text: Open to students in Faculty Jazz and jazz concentration programs, excluding Jazz Performance students.

subject: MUEN
title: Cappella Antica
description: An ensemble of 8 to 12 voices specializing in early music. N.B. This ensemble may substitute as a Basic Ensemble in programs that specify Choral Ensemble, with Departmental approval.

subject: MUEN
title: Baroque Orchestra
description: Open to singers and instrumentalists, this ensemble specializes in chamber music primarily of the Baroque era.

subject: MUEN
title: Afro-Cuban/Brazilian Jazz Combo
description: This course covers Afro-Cuban and Brazilian folk music and the jazz-related music that has come directly from it. Much of the work is based on the rhythmic patterns and grooves from these countries.

restrictions.text: Available to students in B.Mus. Major Performance Jazz, L.Mus. Major Performance Jazz, M.Mus. Jazz Performance and Graduate Diploma in Performance only

notes: Can be taken for a maximum of two semesters.

subject: MUEN
title: Song Interpretation 1
description: Normally open only to Voice and Piano Performance students. Study of the standard song repertoire with emphasis on the singer and pianist as partners. A public recital will be given at the end of each term.

subject: MUEN
title: Song Interpretation 2
description: Study of song repertoire for singers and pianists.

subject: MUEN
title: Early Music Ensemble
description: An ensemble of 4-6 vocalists and instrumentalists which performs music of the Medieval, Renaissance and Baroque periods.

prerequisites.text: Audition. Prerequisite or corequisite for keyboard players: MUPG 272.

subject: MUEN
title: Introduction to Ensemble Playing for Pianists
description: Concentration on interpretation and performance of piano duet and two piano repertoire.

restrictions.text: Open to students in the B. Mus.; Major in Performance Piano and the L. Mus.; Major in Performance Piano.

subject: MUEN
title: Piano Ensembles
description: Ensemble playing in two-piano and piano 4-hand repertoire.

prerequisites.text: MUEN 581 or permission of the instructor.

subject: MUEN
title: Studio Accompanying
description: Highly qualified collaborative partners will be assigned to work independently with studio teachers and their students.

subject: MUEN
title: Sonata Masterclass
description: Exploration of the vast literature for sonatas with piano and instrument, including multiple issues of ensemble preparation and performing.

prerequisites.text: Audition or permission of the instructor.

restrictions.text: Limited to 4 advanced pianists and 4 instrumentalists.

subject: MUEN
title: Opera Coaching
description: Supervised playing of Opera McGill scenes and productions; repetiteur and rehearsal pianist responsibilities; playing of performance of operatic scenes.

prerequisites.text: open to advanced pianists by audition and with the approval of Director of Opera Studies; may be repeated for credit

subject: MUEN
title: Cappella McGill
description: An ensemble of 16 voices performing challenging repertoire from the Renaissance to the present day. Since the expectation is a level of performance equivalent to a professional chamber ensemble, singers wishing to join this group should have had considerable ensemble experience, and advanced vocal and sight-reading skills.
notes: Note: May be taken instead of Choral Ensemble.

subject: MUEN
title: Multiple Ensemble 2
description: Special arrangement ensemble. Topic varies by year.

subject: MUEN
title: Woodwind Ensembles
description: Ensemble for woodwind instruments.

restrictions.text: For Music students; open to others by permission of the Department.

subject: MUEN
title: McGill Wind Orchestra
description: Large ensemble for wind instruments.

subject: MUEN
title: Brass Consort
description: Ensemble for brass instruments.

restrictions.text: For Music students; open to others by permission of the Department.

subject: MUEN
title: Chamber Jazz Ensemble
description: This ensemble will deal with the extensive repertoire of music which exists for small jazz orchestra (9-13 instruments).

restrictions.text: Open to Jazz Performance students only.

subject: MUEN
title: Choral Ensembles
description: Students enrolling in Choral Ensembles will be assigned to one of the above groups.
notes: Section 001 Chamber Singers: a group of approximately 24 mixed voices which explores the a cappella repertoire of all periods as well as works with chamber accompaniment.
Section 002 Concert Choir: an ensemble of approximately 60 voices (S.A.T.B.) which performs the repertoire from all periods appropriate to a group of this size.
Section 003 University Chorus: a mixed chorus of approximately 100 which performs a variety of choral material including both traditional and popular selections.
Section 004 Women's Chorale: an ensemble of approximately 40 women stressing the fundamentals of singing and ensemble participation.

subject: MUEN
title: Contemporary Music Ensemble
description: Ensemble for contemporary music - instruments and voice.

subject: MUEN
title: Jazz Ensembles
description: Ensemble for jazz - instruments and voice.

subject: MUEN
title: Opera Repetiteur
description: Supervised coaching of singers, and playing of scenes and productions; rehearsal pianists and backstage conducting responsibilities.

restrictions.text: Open by audition to advanced pianists, and to students in conducting, who are interested in training as operatic coaches. Students enrolled for piano instruction at McGill must also have their practical teacher's approval

subject: MUEN
title: McGill Symphony Orchestra
description: Ensemble for orchestral instruments.

subject: MUEN
title: Percussion Ensembles
description: Ensemble for percussion instruments.

restrictions.text: For Music students; open to others by permission of the Department.

subject: MUEN
title: Jazz Studio Orchestra
description: Augmented big band orchestra to include strings, clarinets, and other winds and brass as appropriate to the repertoire.
notes: Audition; Instrumentation restrictions vary from year to year on basis of needs of repertoire.

Culminates in a Scenes Program that includes repertoire from the last 400 years of opera, operetta, Singspiel, opéra comique, musical theatre, and 21st century works.

subject: MUEN
title: Studio Accompanying
description: Students will be assigned to work as accompanists with performance teachers and their students.

subject: MUEN
title: Multiple Ensembles
description: Student participation in more than one ensemble in different concert periods over the course of a term.

subject: MUEN
title: Opera Theatre
description: Individual coaching in acting, movement and role preparation; possibility for roles in Opera McGill productions (by audition).
